assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient has intermittent symptomatic arrhythmias.
CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary.
The cardiac event monitor is ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management.
This aligns with the payer's benefit parameters for documented symptomatic arrhythmias requiring rhythm correlation.
